name: Fairmont Royal Palm Marrakech
positioning: Fairmont Royal Palm Marrakech is a golf resort with a riad-style spa and a kids' club, 12 km from the old medina of Marrakech
best_for: Golfers who want a course set against the Atlas Mountains
Families who want a kids' club and a two-bedroom Family Suite
Guests who want a spa day alongside a golf stay

facts.text: The hotel has an 18-hole golf course designed by Cabell B. Robinson, set against the Atlas Mountains.
The Fairmont Spa is designed like a modern riad and offers private treatment rooms for massages, facials and traditional hammam rituals.
The hotel has four restaurants and two bars.
Al Ain is a secluded dining room covered in zellij tiles serving Marrakech cuisine.
The hotel has a kids' club.
The Family Suite has two bedrooms, two bathrooms and two terraces.
The Prince Villa has a private outdoor pool in an enclosed garden, heatable on request, and a private hammam.
The main pool, as well as the Fairmont Spa and Fitness Centre pools, are heated to 28 degrees Celsius.
The hotel is 12 km from the old medina of Marrakech.
The concierge offers a complimentary shuttle service to several points in Marrakech city center.
The Penthouse Suite has a roof terrace and a non-heated private plunge pool.

highlights.text: The hotel has an 18-hole golf course designed by Cabell B. Robinson, set against the Atlas Mountains.
The Fairmont Spa is designed like a modern riad, with private treatment rooms and traditional hammam rituals.
Al Ain is a secluded dining room covered in zellij tiles serving Marrakech cuisine.
The kids' club has a huge playroom that includes a tree house.
The Prince Villa has a private outdoor pool in an enclosed garden, heatable on request, and a private hammam.

considerations.text: The hotel is 12 km from the old medina of Marrakech, so city visits mean using the concierge's complimentary shuttle or other transport.
Access to the spa's indoor swimming pool is reserved for guests aged 18 and over.
The Country Club pool is not heated.
